name: York Timber Holdings Limited
source: CRON 2026-10-13: Profit Before Tax 186,081,000 and Income Tax 52,671,000 filled for FY2026 from York Timber Holdings Limited Audited Consolidated and Separate Financial Statements for the year ended 30 June 2026, Statements of Profit or Loss and Other Comprehensive Income, page 20, figures in R thousands (Deloitte and Touche, unmodified opinion). Printed lines: Gross profit 648 433, Profit from operating activities 245 533, Finance income 14 133, Finance costs 73 585, Profit before tax 186 081, Income tax expense 52 671, Profit from continuing operations 133 410, Loss from discontinued operations 41 745, Profit for the year 91 665. Ties: Profit from operating activities 245 533 less net finance costs 59 452 equals profit before tax 186 081 exactly; profit before tax less the printed income tax equals profit from continuing operations 133 410, and the panel net profit of 91 665 is after the disclosed discontinued operations loss of 41 745, which is the same treatment this file already applies to FY2025 (424 198 less 114 883 equals 309 315 against a stored net profit of 316 538). Source URL https://www.york.co.za/docs/fin/Yorkyearend2026.pdf | Yahoo Finance | CRON r16 (2026-10-12): the FY2026 column was already collected and stored in YRK__income.json for this security but never reached the JSE board, because the listing symbol is YRK.JO and the panel resolves .JO first. The same column is now published here, unchanged, so the newest period renders. Original per-cell provenance is in YRK__income.json.

rows.label: Cost of Sales
rows.derivedFormula: Cost of Sales = Revenue - Gross Profit

rows.label: Operating Expenses
rows.withhold_reason: withheld: Gross Profit - Operating Expenses does not equal the filed Operating Profit and the file carries no extra line that explains the gap, so the operating expenses (or operating profit) cannot be established from the statement; an honest blank beats a figure that fails its own arithmetic
rows.derivedFrom: Operating Expenses = Gross Profit - Operating Profit (EBIT)
rows.derivedBasis: identity holds in every other period of this same file

derivedCellsNote: Individual blank cells derived from the same file own printed inputs, each tagged derived true with its formula and identity agreement rate.
reconciliation_note: Gross Profit - Operating Expenses = Operating Profit (EBIT) does not hold in FY2025; the operating expenses for those periods are withheld (see the row note).
